name: Neural Implicit Surfaces with PBR
aliases: Volume Rendering with PBR and Neural Implicit Surfaces
definition: A method integrating a signed distance function (SDF) with a physically-based rendering (PBR) material model to obtain accurate scene representation, separating specular and diffuse reflections.
summary: Neural Implicit Surfaces with PBR integrates Signed Distance Functions with Physically-Based Rendering to accurately separate specular and diffuse reflections using SDF-derived normals and a precomputed BRDF lookup table.
